guard: CASTLE-24: the vendored site verifier must hash to its pin.

name: M05f operator Verify-tab file byte changed without re-pin
expect: does not match its pinned SHA-256
guard: CASTLE-09: the vendored operator file must hash to its pin before it runs.

name: M05g operator runner changed without re-pin
expect: does not match its pinned SHA-256
guard: CASTLE-09: the runner that executes the operator file is pinned too.

name: M05h operator runner forged (drops the last beacon byte) and re-pinned
guard: CASTLE-09: a re-pinned runner that feeds the operator code the wrong input must be caught by comparing its output with the served position, not only by the pin.

name: M15 the Pass 2 failure count forged and re-pinned

guard: CASTLE-15: every tier meets the floor.

name: M18 a pinned artifact edited without re-pin
guard: CASTLE-27: every artifact of record is pinned.

name: M18b impossible value written AND re-pinned
guard: CASTLE-27: Step 18 checks every numeric leaf against src/domains.ts — a chi-squared fail count above the 1,350 seeds tested is impossible and must fail even though the artifact is re-pinned. (Step 15's replay also catches it; the marker proves the domain check fired on its own.)

name: M19 every wheel position folded onto 0-23
guard: CASTLE-22: Step 19 reacts to the sample — a position census folded onto half the wheel must turn the step to INFO (informational: not counted, verdict unchanged; the run is rejected by the reproduction gate because the committed Step 19 record changes).
